common.poweredBy: Prices and stock are updated from our point of sale.

footer.aboutText: Your neighbourhood mini mercado — fresh produce, drinks and everyday essentials, ordered online and ready for pickup or delivery.
footer.paymentNote: Pay on delivery or at pickup.

home.heroSubtitle: Fresh fruit, cold drinks and daily essentials — ordered in minutes and ready for pickup or delivery.
home.categoriesSubtitle: Everything in the store, organised the way you'd walk it.
home.promoBody: Applies automatically at checkout for addresses within the delivery zone.
home.emptyProductsHint: Once the store adds products they will appear here automatically.

shop.title: Shop
shop.subtitle: Browse everything in the store.
shop.noResultsHint: Try a different search term, or clear the filters to see everything.

shop.loadErrorHint: The store may be temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

category.emptyHint: This category has no products available at the moment.
category.notFoundHint: That category may have been renamed or removed.

product.notFoundHint: This product may have been removed or is no longer sold.
product.maxReached: That's all we have in stock
product.ageNote: This product can only be sold to customers of legal age.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.emptyHint: Browse the shop and add your first items — they'll be saved on this device.
cart.removeConfirmBody: It will be taken out of your cart.

cart.stockChanged: Stock changed while you were shopping
cart.stockChangedHint: Some quantities were reduced to what we currently have available.
cart.availabilityError: We couldn't check availability right now
cart.ageNoticeBody: You'll be asked to confirm your age before placing the order.
cart.savedLocally: Your cart is saved on this device.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.customerSubtitle: We use these to prepare and hand over your order.
checkout.emailHint: Used only for your order confirmation.
checkout.fulfilmentTitle: How would you like to receive it?
checkout.fulfilmentSubtitle: Choose pickup in store or delivery to your address.
checkout.deliveryHint: We'll call to confirm the delivery time.
checkout.pickupHint: Collect at the counter when your order is ready.
checkout.noteHint: Anything we should know? Allergies, doorbell, packing…
checkout.reviewSubtitle: Check the details before placing the order.
checkout.paymentNote: Payment is taken on delivery or at pickup.
checkout.agreeAge: I confirm I am of legal age to purchase the age-restricted items in this order
checkout.agreeAgeRequired: Please confirm your age to continue
checkout.stockWarning: Some items are no longer fully available
checkout.stockWarningHint: Adjust the quantities in your cart, then try again.
checkout.errorBody: Nothing was charged and your cart is still saved. Please try again.
checkout.emptyRedirect: Your cart is empty, so there is nothing to check out.

order.successSubtitle: Thank you — we've received your order and started preparing it.
order.notFoundHint: Check the reference and try again.
order.pendingSyncHint: The full details aren't available to read yet — keep your reference safe and check again shortly.
order.keepReference: Save this reference to track your order later.

track.title: Track your order
track.subtitle: Enter the reference from your confirmation to see the current status.
track.notFoundHint: References look like MATC-4821ABC990. Check it and try again.
track.errorBody: The store may be unavailable right now. Please try again.
track.helper: You can find your reference on the confirmation screen or in your confirmation message.

age.gateBody: This order contains age-restricted products. Confirm that you are of legal age before placing the order.
age.declined: You need to be of legal age to order these items.

errors.unauthorized: The store connection isn't configured correctly. Please contact us.
errors.forbidden: The store connection doesn't have permission for this data.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find what you were looking for.

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.badRequest: That request couldn't be completed. Please try again.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the store. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The store took too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: This storefront isn't connected to the store yet.
errors.genericBody: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
